en_title: Dave Bautista Reveals He's Gained 20 Pounds of Muscle to Play Kratos in the God of War Series
cn_title: Dave Bautista透露为在God of War剧集中饰演奎托斯增重20磅肌肉
opus_summary: Dave Bautista透露，为在Prime Video《战神》剧集中饰演奎托斯，他增肌20磅，体重达到250磅。剧集改编自游戏的北欧神话篇章，已获两季预订。

paragraphs.en: Dave Bautista has revealed he's gained 20 pounds of muscle in preparation for his role as Kratos in Prime Video's God of War series.
paragraphs.cn: Dave Bautista透露，为了准备在Prime Video的God of War剧集中饰演奎托斯，他增重了20磅肌肉。

paragraphs.en: The Guardians of the Galaxy star officially replaced Ryan Hurst in the role back in August, after Hurst tore a bicep during the filming of a stunt for the series and had to be withdrawn from the production due to the estimated length of his recovery. In early September, Bautista shared a video on Instagram flexing his improved physique, noting that he had been weight training for three weeks and had two months to "get where he needs to be."
paragraphs.cn: 这位Guardians of the Galaxy明星早在8月就正式接替Ryan Hurst出演该角色。此前，Hurst在为该剧拍摄一场特技戏时二头肌撕裂，由于预计恢复时间较长，不得不退出制作。9月初，Bautista在Instagram上分享了一段视频，展示自己改善后的体格，并表示他已经进行了三周的负重训练，还有两个月时间「达到他需要达到的状态」。

paragraphs.en: Now it seems those two months are up, with Bautista sharing a new video to his Instagram story with the text "Gained 20 lbs for GOW" and a "250" sticker on it, indicating his current weight. The actor is also wearing a God of War t-shirt in the post.
paragraphs.cn: 现在看来，两个月的时间已经到了。Bautista在Instagram快拍中分享了一段新视频，上面写着「为了GOW增重20磅」，还有一个「250」的贴纸，表明他目前的体重。他在帖子中还穿着一件God of War T恤。

paragraphs.en: Dave Bautista reveals he has gained 20 more pounds of muscle for playing Kratos in ‘GOD OF WAR’.
paragraphs.cn: Dave Bautista透露，为了在「GOD OF WAR」中饰演奎托斯，他又增重了20磅肌肉。

paragraphs.en: He has now reached 250 pounds. https://t.co/fUOr0P7EAB
paragraphs.cn: 他现在的体重已达到250磅。https://t.co/fUOr0P7EAB

paragraphs.en: Bautista, who maintained an average weight of 290 pounds during his WWE wrestling career, had previously lost a lot of his muscle mass in recent years in an effort to open up more diverse acting roles and feel more comfortable on camera. This caused him to slim down quite dramatically, to the point that some God of War fans questioned his suitability to play the musclebound spartan in the Prime Video series after his involvement was confirmed. However, this latest update from the newly buffed-up Bautista sure seems to have proved those naysayers wrong.
paragraphs.cn: Bautista在WWE摔跤生涯中保持着平均290磅的体重，但此前几年，他为了获得更多样化的表演角色，并在镜头前感到更自在，减掉了大量肌肉。这让他明显瘦了下来，以至于在他确认参演后，一些God of War粉丝质疑他是否适合在Prime Video剧集中饰演这位肌肉发达的斯巴达人。不过，重新练得壮硕的Bautista分享的这一最新进展，似乎确实证明了那些质疑者是错的。

paragraphs.en: Prime Video's God of War series is set to be based on the Norse mythology era of the PlayStation videogame franchise, and will follow father and son Kratos (Bautista) and Atreus (Callum Vinson) as they embark on a journey to spread the ashes of their wife and mother, Faye, at the highest peak of the nine realms. Two seasons of the show have been ordered.
paragraphs.cn: Prime Video的God of War剧集将以该PlayStation电子游戏系列的北欧神话时代为基础，讲述父子奎托斯（Bautista饰）和Atreus（Callum Vinson饰）踏上旅程，将他们的妻子和母亲Faye的骨灰撒在九界最高峰的故事。该剧已获预订两季。
